definition: to sit or lie back comfortably doing nothing
description: A run of people settling into total idleness: a construction worker in a hi-vis vest drops back onto a living-room sofa with his boots up; a woman lies stretched out in a white hammock under palm trees with her hands behind her head; a shirtless man reclines on a striped beach lounger under an umbrella, sipping from a can; a man lies flat in a green field under a blue sky; a woman lounges in a hammock on the sand as the sun sets over the sea.
